findings.finding: All retained media integrity, metadata, source/atlas crops and runtime-reference checks passed.
All synchronized source and atlas packet presentation timestamps are freshly checked; no source timing changes are introduced by the layout.
SSIM values are existing full-duration records bound to verified source/output hashes, not newly computed and not a substitute for current visual review.
The active revised occlusion-kangaroo atlas is 6,697,790 bytes larger than the historical version; this is a content refresh, not CSS growth.

Historical report ranges/counts describe 15 groups and 64 sources before later curation. Current page uses 12 groups / 43 static video elements; the active recorded atlas-panel SSIM minimum is 0.982214.
Larger comparison canvases increase potential destination-pixel copying, especially portrait Spin; browser runtime evaluation is separate.

historical_5second_browser_measurements.status: Historical measurements retained as provenance; not rerun by this audit.

inventory.byte_total_definition: Complete unique file sizes for all displayed resources, not initial network transfer; browser lazy-loading, caching, range requests and aborted requests change observed transfers. Default mode uses 12 atlases plus method/wipe and 9 viewer clips; fallback mode uses individual source panels.

default_complete_local_resource_inventor.definition: Unique file sizes for every selectable scene and displayed group in this mode, including HTML and posters; excludes external Google Fonts/Analytics and is not a measured network transfer.

fallback_complete_local_resource_invento.definition: Unique file sizes for every selectable scene and displayed group in this mode, including HTML and posters; excludes external Google Fonts/Analytics and is not a measured network transfer.

synchronized_decoder_reduction.definition: For the 12 synchronized groups after loading them; not simultaneous playing counts. Method, correction wipe and viewer thumbnails are separate.

layout_cost_analysis.basis: Analytical CSS geometry at maximum 1200px section width with 40px padding on each side; not browser/GPU measurements. Canvas DPR and native-resolution caps still apply.
layout_cost_analysis.potential_cost: Larger visible canvases copy more destination pixels, especially Spin; no additional video decoders or encoded video bytes are introduced by CSS.

provenance.resource_byte_inventory_basis: Committed blob sizes at HEAD 8db57b302a0c1e490958d27b1eb8028c9edf358a, avoiding parallel viewer/test changes during audit. Selected asset paths and all media files are unchanged by those parallel changes.

quality.measurement_scope: Recorded all-frame native-resolution per-panel SSIM; source and generated hashes freshly validated by existing validator.
quality.note: Historical 0.984504 lower bound excludes the later revised kangaroo content. Comparing SSIM across different source content is not an apples-to-apples quality regression measurement.
quality.poster_validation_limitation: The manifest stores JPEG size and recipe, but not poster SHA-256. The validator checks poster file sizes, JPEG codec and dimensions; it does not prove pixel identity.

scope: Read-only media inventory and validation; only this JSON evidence file was written. No media re-encoding, SSIM recomputation, browser execution, or production requests.
units: bytes (decimal MB=1,000,000bytes); timings in seconds unless stated

validation.metadata_and_packet_probe_method: ffprobe stream headers and video packets only; sorted presentation timestamps compared as exact rational seconds. No newly decoded frames or new perceptual quality metrics.
